scope: I compare all eight completed layer-12 prompt-split held-out accuracies with the archived independent H200 reproduction. I do not change or rerun the recipe.
verdict: I find reassuring agreement on all eight layer-12 held-out accuracies at the precision of the local log, including the suca probe required for gardening. I find no material accuracy mismatch that warrants changing or interrupting the run.

formulas.reference_accuracy: sum(count where role==pred) / sum(count) within layer12 and role_space
formulas.difference_percentage_points: 100 * (local rounded log accuracy - reference confusion-derived accuracy)
formulas.denominator: held-out labeled content-token rows for that role-space split
formulas.local_log_rounding: Accuracy is printed to three decimals, so rounding alone accounts for up to0.05 percentage point.

qualifications: I compare with an independent H200 reproduction, not the original paper-trained artifact.
Equal token denominators do not independently establish identical test group IDs in the historical H200 run.
The warnings do not establish solver convergence; matching accuracy does not establish coefficient equality, calibration or matching gardening probabilities.
The logged suca negative log likelihood0.727 has no historical counterpart in this confusion CSV, so I do not claim NLL agreement.
The native-pickle convergence/finite-coefficient audit and the actual gardening forward/figures remain separate checks.
